The '''Noryath system''' was located in the [[Nuiri sector/Legends|Nuiri sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|product]] known as [[Noryath brown meatbread]].<ref name="BtS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Noryath brown meatbread]]|system=Noryath [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Noryath [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
